name: ZOE_OL_CONNECTED_CLIENTS
description: This table stores the details of Fusion CRM for Microsoft Outlook clients connected to the Fusion server.

columns.name: CLIENT_ID
columns.description: System generated identifier for this client.

columns.name: METADATA_PACKAGE_VERSION
columns.description: Package Version

columns.name: CLIENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the client.

columns.name: CLIENT_BUILD_NUMBER
columns.description: Build number of the client

columns.name: CLIENT_USER
columns.description: User registered with this client.

columns.name: CLIENT_USER_ROLE
columns.description: Entereprise role of the user registered with this client.

columns.name: USER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the registered user.

columns.name: LAST_SYNC_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Overall status of last sync with the server.

columns.name: LAST_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: The latest date time on which this client was synced with the server.

columns.name: PAST_WEEK_SYNC_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Number of times client attempted to sync with the server over the past week

columns.name: PAST_MONTH_SYNC_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Number of times client attempted to sync with the server over the past month.

columns.name: RECENT_CHANGES_SYNC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether recent changes are synchronized into the connected device.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_SYNC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether automatic synchronization is enabled for this client.

columns.name: RECENT_CHANGES_SYNC_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Indicates how often this connected device sychronized the recent changes from the hosted server.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_SYNC_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Indicates how often this connected device automatically sychronized  from the hosted server.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_SUCCESS_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: The latest date time when this client was successfully synced with the server.
